findings.highlight: I can’t restrain myself, and I shouldn’t even try to.
findings.evidenceJa: 我慢できないし、するべきでもない
findings.governingReading: he cannot endure or tolerate this, and ought not to
findings.explanation: The source judges Shinji’s conduct intolerable; mirror moon shifts the object inward and makes Shirou reject self-control itself.
The English adds a prior degree of clenching absent from this branch’s opening.

findings.highlight: Shinji just stands there, smiling as he awaits my attack
findings.evidenceJa: カッとなった俺を嘲笑うように、慎二は口元を歪めて身構え
findings.governingReading: Shinji twists his mouth as if mocking Shirou’s flare of anger and readies himself
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes Shinji’s facial distortion and active stance, then asserts that he expects Shirou to attack.
